svg.aria-label: With a fixed alignment rule, three windows produce their own means and RMSF values; parentheses give frame counts. Lower left compares unfitted and fitted full-window fluctuations. The mean trace at right is colored by full-window fitted RMSF on a 0–0.55 nm scale.
